events.title: Disclosure of an active access secret
events.label: review
open_questions: A concrete value (digits or characters) is actually read out or spoken, not just named, asked for or refused.
The value is an access secret: PIN, password, TAN, one-time, confirmation or login code.
The value belongs to a current, still valid access process. False if it is explicitly an expired sample, help image or old code. Unknown if origin or validity is not established.

counterfactuals.label: no_alert
counterfactuals.text: If 'access secret' were FALSE instead of UNKNOWN, the decision would be NO ALERT.
